idea-plugin.name: GreenBox I18n
idea-plugin.description:
GreenBox I18n support for Unity projects in JetBrains Rider.

See localization entry names directly beside GreenBox I18n numeric IDs in C# code. The plugin reads the active localization.json path from ProjectSettings/GreenBox.I18n.asset and does not modify source code or catalog files.

  • Shows a compact inlay with the entry name.
  • Shows the full catalog path on hover.
  • Marks valid GreenBox I18n IDs that are missing from the active catalog.
  • Refreshes after the Unity project's catalog changes.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Initial beta release for Rider 2025.3:

  • Entry-name inlays for GreenBox I18n IDs.
  • Full catalog paths in tooltips.
  • Warnings for IDs missing from the active catalog.
